title: 1812 Prairie's front in stone and brick, as its photograph shows
items: The Wheeler house at 1812 Prairie is no longer stone from the walk to the gable. Its basement and the entrance bay's first storey stay stone; over the second floor's belt the front is brick, banded and dressed in stone, as Albert Levy's photograph shows it.
The south projection is brick over its rock-faced basement, its bands, sills and window heads still stone, and the second storey's north window stands in a quoined stone surround.
Houses built on the same kit can now stop their stone at a floor line and carry brick above it.
